decisions.reason: The submarine lighting line required substantial specialized investment and opens a visible maritime niche, so management will stick with it despite its distance from the core and attribute slow uptake to long naval procurement cycles.
The explosion-proof line builds on core competence, has its own page and has received follow-up investment such as the LED replacement kit, which makes the firm strongly committed to it.
The relaunch of the popular designer task light was publicly announced and fits the core offer, so management will defend it even though its single-model scope makes it easier to drop.
The pendant office luminaire is a recent launch close to the core LED office range, and weak results can still be blamed on pandemic-related declines in office projects.
The premium pendant line with several models represents a visible investment that is central to the firm's energy-efficient LED direction, so management will persist with it.
